content:
I am delighted to share that my research article has been published in Volume VI (2025) of the Himachal Pradesh National Law University Shimla Journal of Environment and Disaster Management, published by Himachal Pradesh National Law University (HPNLU), Shimla.

Having my work published in a peer-reviewed academic journal is a valuable milestone and an encouraging step in my continued engagement with legal research.

I am grateful to the editorial team at HPNLU for providing this platform and for their efforts in bringing the publication to fruition. I also extend my sincere thanks my co author Venkat K for his contribution and support throughout this journey.

Looking forward to further exploring the intersection of law, environmental governance, and contemporary legal challenges through research and academic contributions.

Publication: HPNLU Journal of Environment and Disaster Management, Vol. VI (2025).

Journal Link: https://lnkd.in/d5fP_yrt

comment: Environmental law research becomes particularly consequential when it bridges statutory obligations with on-ground enforcement, institutional accountability, and the practical realities of disaster management.
